weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. Inflicts Spd/Res-6 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.

assist.d: Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+7, but after combat, if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-2 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-4 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-6 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.
